subject: Intro: AWS co-sell & joint account plan for Clearmap / AcmeHealth
messages:
From: AWS Partner BD <aws-partner-bd@amazon.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intro: Clearmap / AcmeHealth - potential co-sell opportunity

Hi Stephanie / Vivek,

Quick intro — Clearmap (health analytics startup) is evaluating an LLM inference platform to power clinical summarization for AcmeHealth. I’m connecting you with their buyer, Mark Turner (cc), who asked about an AWS co-sell path and marketplace listing to accelerate procurement.

High-level asks from Clearmap/AcmeHealth:
- Proof of SOC 2 and data residency options
- Rough pricing for a pilot (up to ~50k tokens/day)
- Timeline for an AWS Marketplace listing & co-sell enablement

Can we schedule a 30-min intro next week to align on a joint account plan and roles? AWS can join to help frame the funding/credits conversation.

Thanks,
Carla Mendes
AWS Partner BD
aws-partner-bd@amazon.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Mark Turner <mark.turner@acmehealth.com>, Lily Zhao <lily.zhao@clearmap.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Carla Mendes <aws-partner-bd@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro: Clearmap / AcmeHealth - potential co-sell opportunity

Hi Mark / Lily — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks Carla for the connect.

We’d love to run a short kickoff to clarify scope and draft a simple joint account plan (JAP) so everyone has clear next steps. Candidate agenda:
- 10m intros & success criteria
- 10m security/compliance checklist (SOC2, data routing)
- 10m procurement path & marketplace questions
- Next steps / owners

Available slots next week (PST): Mon 11/30 9:30–10:00am, Tue 12/1 11:00–11:30am, Wed 12/2 2:00–2:30pm. Please pick one that works and we’ll send a calendar invite.

I’ll attach a short JAP template and a security one-pager for the meeting.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
attachment: Redwood_JAP_draft.xlsx (sheet: timeline)
attachment: redwood-security-one-pager.pdf

From: Mark Turner <mark.turner@acmehealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Lily Zhao <lily.zhao@clearmap.ai>
Cc: Carla Mendes <aws-partner-bd@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 13:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Intro: Clearmap / AcmeHealth - potential co-sell opportunity

Hi Stephanie — thanks for the quick turnaround. Tue 12/1 11:00am PST works for me.

A few items to prioritize in the kickoff:
- SOC 2 type II report and whether Redwood supports US regional data residency (we’re considering HIPAA-bound workflows)
- Pilot pricing ballpark (monthly committed vs usage) and any co-sell credits or incentives through AWS
- Typical onboarding timeline for a proof-of-concept and support SLA during pilot

If you can share the JAP draft ahead of the meeting that would be helpful.

Thanks,
Mark Turner
Head of Data Platforms, AcmeHealth
mark.turner@acmehealth.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0198

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Mark Turner <mark.turner@acmehealth.com>, Lily Zhao <lily.zhao@clearmap.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Carla Mendes <aws-partner-bd@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 08:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro: Clearmap / AcmeHealth - potential co-sell opportunity

Thanks Mark — meeting confirmed for Tue 12/1 11:00am PST (invitation sent).

Attaching the JAP draft (short, editable) and our security one-pager. Highlights in the draft:
- Pilot scope: clinical note summarization, up to 50k tokens/day; 4-week pilot + 8-week evaluation
- Owners: Redwood AE (Stephanie) / Clearmap PM (Lily) / AcmeHealth technical lead (Mark) / AWS partner BD (Carla)
- Success metrics: latency < 250ms p95 for 512 tokens, accuracy targets on extractive summaries, and integration timeline
- Procurement path options: direct purchase, AWS Marketplace listing (preferred for faster procurement), or Dedicated Reserved pool for production

attachment: Redwood_JAP_draft.xlsx
attachment: redwood-security-one-pager.pdf

Please flag anything you want changed before the call.

--
Stephanie

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carla Mendes <aws-partner-bd@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro: Clearmap / AcmeHealth - potential co-sell opportunity

Quick note after reviewing the JAP draft — thanks Steph, good structure. A couple of asks before we go into the co-sell conversation with AWS: 
- Marissa, can you take point on the marketplace pre-req checklist (listing docs, pricing SKU, entitlement model) and estimate lead time?
- Karthik, can you confirm whether the proposed pilot pricing aligns with our co-sell discount tiers (I think metric-based discount applies)?

Carla / AWS — if there are standard co-sell funding or credits for healthcare pilots, please flag so we can document them in the JAP.

Vivek
VP, Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
